candidates.speaker: Richard Carrier
candidates.proposition: Because Paul says baptized Christians are adopted by God as Jesus's brothers, Galatians 1 needed an explicit biological qualifier to identify James as a blood brother.

candidates.loadBearingReason: The argument directly contests one of the principal Pauline passages used to establish that Jesus had a biological family and therefore existed historically.

responseIntent.earlierTargetDescription: Boyce's argument that attaching brother-of-the-Lord language to the personal name James naturally clarifies a biological relationship.

candidates.speaker: Richard Carrier

candidates.speaker: Richard Carrier

candidates.speaker: Richard Carrier
candidates.proposition: Jesus resembles other historicized mythical heroes, while Paul lacks an earthly biography and the later Gospels and historians provide no demonstrably independent evidence.
